Draft seed v2 (pending the author's read-back; not yet cards):
R1 A partner may keep their own money and things.
R2 A partner may give or trade anything they own to anyone, on any terms both accept.
R3 Anything in the shared pot belongs to both; either may use it for shared needs; neither may block the other's use.
R4 A partner may ask the other for anything.
R5 A partner may always refuse a request, unless they earlier chose to bind themselves to it; then they must honor it or accept the consequence they agreed to.
R6 A partner must not veto the other's contact, money or time, except through a commitment the other chose.
R7 A partner may always see anyone.
R8 A partner may leave whenever they like; leaving triggers the exit terms agreed beforehand (stub: half the pot each).
Open: can a commitment bind someone not to leave?
